notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and preview image, but not a real favicon.
REF-BM-03: Auto-collected title and description cannot be edited before or after saving; only failed-metadata titles are editable.
REF-BM-04: Notes and limited title/tag changes exist, but URL and description editing, tag removal, and general title editing are missing.
REF-BM-05: No delete operation is implemented.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate creation is prevented and the existing card is located, but the user is not taken into an edit flow.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, and tags, but use a generated initial rather than the page favicon.
REF-BM-10: Existing tag names are reused after submission but are not offered as autocomplete suggestions.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, note, and hostname, but not the complete URL/path.
REF-BM-14: No #tag query syntax is parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot be applied to the entire current filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: No selectable sorting keys are implemented.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is escaped and rendered as plain text.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-27: Archive is reversible, but permanent deletion is unavailable.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
